files.description: Primary EHI export documentation — a single-page PDF describing the export as C-CDA 2.1 XML and PDF in ZIP format. Contains overview, file format description, and 4-step export process. No data dictionary, no schema, no sample data. Created 2023-12-15.

CEHRT transparency disclosures for Axxess Palliative Version 3.0.2022. 3-page PDF listing all certified criteria with brief descriptions and cost/fee information. The (b)(10) entry states the product enables export of 'all of a single patient's or population of patient's electronic health information'. No additional technical detail beyond the b10 PDF.

Full-page screenshot of the CEHRT compliance hub page showing the two-column layout of certification documents. The b10 EHI Export PDF is linked in the right column alongside Real World Testing plans/reports and CHPL listing link.
